github.description: GitHub's hosted default MCP toolsets can include write actions. Host-managed OAuth or a manually configured token is subject to account and organization permissions; no credentials or connections are generated. Source: https://github.com/github/github-mcp-server/blob/main/docs/remote-server.md

github-readonly.description: GitHub's hosted default MCP toolsets with the documented read-only tool filter. Account access and other servers remain separate; authenticate manually through the host. No credentials or connections are generated. Source: https://github.com/github/github-mcp-server/blob/main/docs/remote-server.md

github-all.description: GitHub's hosted all-toolsets MCP route can include write actions. Host-managed OAuth or a manually configured token is subject to account and organization permissions; no credentials or connections are generated. Source: https://github.com/github/github-mcp-server/blob/main/docs/remote-server.md

github-all-readonly.description: GitHub's hosted all-toolsets MCP route with the documented read-only tool filter. Account access and other servers remain separate; authenticate manually through the host. No credentials or connections are generated. Source: https://github.com/github/github-mcp-server/blob/main/docs/remote-server.md

openai-docs.description: OpenAI's public documentation-only MCP server provides search and page content without calling the OpenAI API. A future connection sends search queries to the service; no connection or client configuration is performed by Weaver. Source: https://developers.openai.com/learn/docs-mcp

perplexity.description: Official hosted Perplexity MCP. Authenticate manually with OAuth or an API key through the host; API organization billing and tool permissions require review. Source: https://docs.perplexity.ai/docs/getting-started/integrations/mcp-server

perplexity-computer.description: Official Perplexity Computer MCP, separate from the API MCP. Authenticate through a compatible host using Perplexity-account OAuth 2.0; no API key is used. Task usage consumes account credits and can involve connected-service write actions. Model and effort options require authenticated account-scoped models_list discovery; runtime access and availability remain unverified. Weaver does not authenticate, connect or start tasks. Source: https://docs.perplexity.ai/docs/getting-started/integrations/computer-mcp-server
